title: El Principito / The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
description: A poetic tale about a young prince who visits various planets, learning about life and love.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Una vez, cuando tenía seis años, vi una magnífica imagen en un libro sobre la selva virgen que se llamaba "Historias vividas". Representaba una serpiente boa que se tragaba a una fiera.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: Once when I was six years old I saw a magnificent picture in a book about the primeval forest called "True Stories." It showed a boa constrictor swallowing a wild animal.
paragraphs.originalText: Una vez, cuando tenía seis años, vi una magnífica imagen en un libro sobre la selva virgen que se llamaba "Historias vividas". Representaba una serpiente boa que se tragaba a una fiera.
paragraphs.translatedText: Once when I was six years old I saw a magnificent picture in a book about the primeval forest called "True Stories." It showed a boa constrictor swallowing a wild animal.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: En el libro decía: "Las serpientes boas tragan a sus presas enteras, sin masticarlas. Luego no pueden moverse y duermen durante los seis meses de la digestión".
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: In the book it said: "Boa constrictors swallow their prey whole, without chewing it. After that they are not able to move, and they sleep through the six months that they need for digestion."
paragraphs.originalText: En el libro decía: "Las serpientes boas tragan a sus presas enteras, sin masticarlas. Luego no pueden moverse y duermen durante los seis meses de la digestión".
paragraphs.translatedText: In the book it said: "Boa constrictors swallow their prey whole, without chewing it. After that they are not able to move, and they sleep through the six months that they need for digestion."

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Reflexioné mucho sobre las aventuras de la jungla y, a mi vez, logré trazar con un lápiz de colores mi primer dibujo. Mi dibujo número 1 era así.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: I pondered deeply over the adventures of the jungle, and in turn, managed to trace with a colored pencil my first drawing. My Drawing Number One looked like this.
paragraphs.originalText: Reflexioné mucho sobre las aventuras de la jungla y, a mi vez, logré trazar con un lápiz de colores mi primer dibujo. Mi dibujo número 1 era así.
paragraphs.translatedText: I pondered deeply over the adventures of the jungle, and in turn, managed to trace with a colored pencil my first drawing. My Drawing Number One looked like this.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Mostré mi obra de arte a las personas mayores y les pregunté si mi dibujo les daba miedo. Me contestaron: "¿Por qué habría de asustarnos un sombrero?"
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: I showed my masterpiece to the grown-ups and asked them if my drawing frightened them. They answered: "Why should anyone be frightened by a hat?"
paragraphs.originalText: Mostré mi obra de arte a las personas mayores y les pregunté si mi dibujo les daba miedo. Me contestaron: "¿Por qué habría de asustarnos un sombrero?"
paragraphs.translatedText: I showed my masterpiece to the grown-ups and asked them if my drawing frightened them. They answered: "Why should anyone be frightened by a hat?"

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Viví así, solo, sin nadie con quien hablar verdaderamente, hasta que tuve una avería en el desierto del Sahara, hace seis años. Algo se había roto en mi motor.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: So I lived alone, without anyone I could really talk to, until I had a breakdown in the Sahara Desert, six years ago. Something had broken in my engine.
paragraphs.originalText: Viví así, solo, sin nadie con quien hablar verdaderamente, hasta que tuve una avería en el desierto del Sahara, hace seis años. Algo se había roto en mi motor.
paragraphs.translatedText: So I lived alone, without anyone I could really talk to, until I had a breakdown in the Sahara Desert, six years ago. Something had broken in my engine.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Y como no llevaba conmigo ni mecánico ni pasajeros, me dispuse a intentar solo y sin ayuda una reparación difícil. Era para mí cuestión de vida o muerte. Apenas tenía agua para ocho días.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: And as I had neither a mechanic nor passengers with me, I set myself to attempt the difficult repair all alone. It was a matter of life and death for me. I had barely enough drinking water for eight days.
paragraphs.originalText: Y como no llevaba conmigo ni mecánico ni pasajeros, me dispuse a intentar solo y sin ayuda una reparación difícil. Era para mí cuestión de vida o muerte. Apenas tenía agua para ocho días.
paragraphs.translatedText: And as I had neither a mechanic nor passengers with me, I set myself to attempt the difficult repair all alone. It was a matter of life and death for me. I had barely enough drinking water for eight days.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: La primera noche dormí sobre la arena, a mil millas de toda tierra habitada. Estaba más aislado que un náufrago sobre una balsa en medio del océano.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: The first night I went to sleep on the sand, a thousand miles from any inhabited land. I was more isolated than a shipwrecked sailor on a raft in the middle of the ocean.
paragraphs.originalText: La primera noche dormí sobre la arena, a mil millas de toda tierra habitada. Estaba más aislado que un náufrago sobre una balsa en medio del océano.
paragraphs.translatedText: The first night I went to sleep on the sand, a thousand miles from any inhabited land. I was more isolated than a shipwrecked sailor on a raft in the middle of the ocean.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Así que pueden imaginar mi sorpresa cuando, al amanecer, me despertó una vocecita extraña que decía: "Por favor... ¡dibújame un cordero!"
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: So you can imagine my surprise when I was awakened at daybreak by an odd little voice saying: "Please... draw me a sheep!"
paragraphs.originalText: Así que pueden imaginar mi sorpresa cuando, al amanecer, me despertó una vocecita extraña que decía: "Por favor... ¡dibújame un cordero!"
paragraphs.translatedText: So you can imagine my surprise when I was awakened at daybreak by an odd little voice saying: "Please... draw me a sheep!"

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Me llevó mucho tiempo comprender de dónde venía. El principito, que me hacía muchas preguntas, jamás parecía oír las mías.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: It took me a long time to understand where he came from. The little prince, who asked me so many questions, never seemed to hear mine.
paragraphs.originalText: Me llevó mucho tiempo comprender de dónde venía. El principito, que me hacía muchas preguntas, jamás parecía oír las mías.
paragraphs.translatedText: It took me a long time to understand where he came from. The little prince, who asked me so many questions, never seemed to hear mine.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Fueron palabras pronunciadas al azar las que, poco a poco, me revelaron todo. Así, cuando vio mi avión por primera vez, me preguntó: "¿Qué cosa es esa?"
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: It was words spoken by chance that, little by little, revealed everything to me. Thus, when he saw my airplane for the first time, he asked: "What is that thing?"
paragraphs.originalText: Fueron palabras pronunciadas al azar las que, poco a poco, me revelaron todo. Así, cuando vio mi avión por primera vez, me preguntó: "¿Qué cosa es esa?"
paragraphs.translatedText: It was words spoken by chance that, little by little, revealed everything to me. Thus, when he saw my airplane for the first time, he asked: "What is that thing?"

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: "No es una cosa. Vuela. Es un avión. Es mi avión." Y me sentí orgulloso de hacerle saber que yo volaba.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: "It is not a thing. It flies. It is an airplane. It is my airplane." And I was proud to let him know that I flew.
paragraphs.originalText: "No es una cosa. Vuela. Es un avión. Es mi avión." Y me sentí orgulloso de hacerle saber que yo volaba.
paragraphs.translatedText: "It is not a thing. It flies. It is an airplane. It is my airplane." And I was proud to let him know that I flew.

paragraphs.originalText_spanish: Entonces él exclamó: "¡Cómo! ¿Has caído del cielo?" "Sí", le dije modestamente. "¡Qué gracioso!" Y el principito soltó una encantadora carcajada que me irritó mucho.
paragraphs.translatedText_spanish: Then he cried: "What! You fell from the sky?" "Yes," I said modestly. "How funny!" And the little prince broke into a lovely peal of laughter which irritated me very much.
paragraphs.originalText: Entonces él exclamó: "¡Cómo! ¿Has caído del cielo?" "Sí", le dije modestamente. "¡Qué gracioso!" Y el principito soltó una encantadora carcajada que me irritó mucho.
paragraphs.translatedText: Then he cried: "What! You fell from the sky?" "Yes," I said modestly. "How funny!" And the little prince broke into a lovely peal of laughter which irritated me very much.
